reasons: The rule expects an insurance clause and the document has none — the only 'insurance' reference is an accounting exclusion in the Net Revenue definition — so a 'missing' classification is correct for Commerce One, a licensor/hosting vendor whose MarketSite Service touches Corio and Customer data.

The inserted 14.10 tracks the playbook model language (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M where Customer data is processed, workers' comp, certificates on request) and correctly binds the counterparty (Commerce One), not our party.

Edit is minimal and structurally clean: new section added after 14.9 and the existing Complete Understanding clause renumbered to 14.11, with the execution sentence and all other text preserved (changed-character ratio 0.069).
Comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice with the [Playbook] prefix, and offers the fallback limits (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) without lecturing.
